versions.changelog:
Initial release of kobi-tesvik-tr:

- Provides a comprehensive guide to incentives, grants, and support programs for SMEs in Turkey.
- Covers KOSGEB, TÜBİTAK, İŞKUR, development agency supports, and tax exemptions.
- Matches available incentives based on company sector, size, and profile.
- Includes command-line tool for automatic incentive matching.
- Contains extensive reference documents for each major support program.
- Developed by Finhouse (finhouse.ai) for Turkish SME support.
